observations: widget bootstrap POSTs per page load (…/api/widget/<key>/bootstrap, all 200): c1440 26/13, c1024 24/13, c768 24/13, c390 22/13, c375 24/13, w390 2/2 — Chromium usually sends TWO per page view (hello on iframe load + on shell ready), WebKit one. <meta name="robots" content="noindex"> is present on the pages (recorded, not judged).
